div.head: Hn com 2
div.ab: Et nolo, ut uicecomes meus, propter aliquod necessarium suum quod sibi pertineat, faciat ea sedere aliter.
Et nolo ut vicecomes meus propter aliquod necessarium suum quod sibi pertineat faciat ea sedere aliter.
And it is not my wish that my sheriff should make them sit at any other time or in any other place for any business pertaining to himself.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 524, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: Nur für die regelmässigen, gewöhnlichen Rechts- und Verwaltungsgeschäfte, deren Ertrag der Beamte pachtet, gilt dies. Ohne besonderen Kronauftrag darf der Sheriff (s. d. Gl 13c. e; Grafschaft 14b; Gericht 9d. 22—c) nicht gebotenes Ding ansetzen

This applies only to the regular, ordinary judicial and administrative business, the revenue from which the official holds at farm. Without a special commission from the Crown the sheriff (see that word in Gl 13c. e; Grafschaft 14b; Gericht 9d. 22—c) may not appoint a specially summoned court
